scope: Focused audit of early South Asia political boundary vectors before 1000 CE; not an exhaustive absence claim

leads.name: NATMO Ancient India (Cultural)
leads.evidence: Official catalog lists Cultural as vector with WMS/PDF. Dataset page could not be retrieved: timeout and DNS failure.
leads.decision: candidate_only; retrieve actual capabilities and dated feature schema before import
leads.confidence: high for catalog existence; unknown for usable political geometry

leads.name: NATMO Ancient India (Physical)
leads.evidence: Official metadata: physical landscape/physiography, vector; scale 1:14,000,000; Lambert Conformal Conic. Mapping 2014, digitizing 2019, metadata 2020 are production years. Temporal fields tlate, tearly, period and precision are NA.
leads.caution: NA temporal metadata observed for Physical only, not Cultural.

leads.name: IDSA GIS Lab, One Hundred Years of Kautilya’s Arthasastra
leads.evidence: Indexed primary PDF excerpt identifies plate India during post Maurya and Gupta times (CE 100-500), copyright IDSA GIS Lab, Map not to scale. Full PDF was not inspected.
leads.geometry_schema: PDF illustrative plate; no vector feature schema obtained
leads.historical_dates: 100–500 CE broad period, not an exact-year snapshot
leads.decision: reference candidate only; do not create exact-year boundary from this evidence
leads.confidence: high for indexed plate text; no geospatial accuracy established

leads.name: Xatra
leads.evidence: Source README uses GADM administrative boundary unions, e.g. Maurya = gadm(IND) | gadm(PAK); downloads modern GADM and Natural Earth.
leads.geometry_schema: modern GADM-derived geometry used by map framework
leads.decision: reject as independent ancient historical boundary upgrade
